For Flora.
To be read one room at a time.

Winter PreludeFor Flora · 25 October 2026

Proem

Before the Cold

For Flora

Somewhere between your windowand mine,October changes its light.

I fold a little warmthinto a suitcase.The rest will have to be said in person.

Leave a place beside you.I am comingto fill it.

Winter PreludeFor Flora · 25 October 2026

I

Across the Distance

For months, we have livedon either sideof a small, bright screen.

Soon I will see youwithout reaching for it,without asking if you can hear me.

The journey is long.What I want at the end of itis ordinary:your door opening.

Winter PreludeFor Flora · 25 October 2026

II

A Little Warmth

A scarf keepsno record of winter.

Only the foldwhere you tuck your chin,the ends caught beneath your coat.

When we step outside,let me straighten itbefore we go.

Winter PreludeFor Flora · 25 October 2026

III

A Scent for Winter

A small warmth to keep nearby.

For the evenings when the room is quiet and the weather turns colder, I wanted to leave you something warm.

Smoke, chestnut, soft firelight — a scent that feels a little like winter, and a little like staying in.

So even when I am not beside you yet, a small part of the season can be.

Winter PreludeFor Flora · 25 October 2026

Interlude

The Room at Night

A page left open.The cat asleepwhere the next page should be.

For a while,nothing needs finishing.

Stay here.The lamp is enough.

Winter PreludeFor Flora · 25 October 2026

III

The Days Ahead

Your keys. Your phone.A note folded small.

There should be roomfor an evening with no plan,for a turn you takebecause the street looks beautiful.

Not every dayhas to lead somewhere.

Winter PreludeFor Flora · 25 October 2026

Coda

October, With You

Today, let the yearask nothing of you.

A candle.Another slice.My hand, beside yourson the table.

Happy birthday, Flora.

For once, the distancehas nothing to say.

Winter PreludeFor Flora · 25 October 2026

A letter

For Flora,

May this winter be soft on you — warm rooms, quiet nights, and little moments that make everything feel lighter.

Even in the coldest season, I hope you always feel loved, cared for, and beautifully yourself.

Happy birthday, my love.

Our winter begins here.
